column1: # note: The 2025 Maine Tax Rate Schedules. The table covers line 19 under $52,000, so the test holds the schedules only from $52,000.

# note: The schedules print "less than" and "or more", so an income equal to a bracket's start belongs to that bracket. Each base is the tax at that start rounded to the dollar, so either bracket gives the same whole-dollar tax there.
# note: Schedule 1 covers single and married filing separately, schedule 3 married filing jointly and surviving spouses, schedule 2 head of household. Each is repeated for every status it covers.
# note: Line 20 is entered in whole dollars.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
